mapper.select: SELECT C.CONT_NO AS contNo , C.CTRY_NO AS ctryNo , C.COIN_NO AS coinNo , C.COIN_YEARS AS coinYears , C.COIN_YEAR2S AS coinYear2s , CONT.CODE_NAME AS contName , CTRY.CODE_NAME AS ctryName , CN.CODE_NAME AS coinName , CN.CODE_ETC AS coinEtc , COALESCE(CT.cnt, 0) AS ctryCnt FROM COIN C LEFT JOIN CODE CONT ON CONT.CODE_DIV = 'CONT' AND CONT.CODE_NO = C.CONT_NO LEFT JOIN CODE CTRY ON CTRY.CODE_DIV = 'CTRY' AND CTRY.CODE_NO = C.CTRY_NO LEFT JOIN CODE CN ON CN.CODE_DIV = 'COIN' AND CN.CODE_NO = C.COIN_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT CTRY_NO, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM COIN GROUP BY CTRY_NO) CT ON CT.CTRY_NO = C.CTRY_NO ORDER BY C.CONT_NO, C.CTRY_NO, C.COIN_NO
